all_findings.msg: __bt2/.env.example: DATABASE_URL uses port 5432 (direct URL) — MUST use port 6543 (pooled). Risk: 42P05 under concurrency.
__bt2/.env.example: DATABASE_URL does not use port 6543 — Supabase pgBouncer pooler required for serverless/multi-app.
__bt2/.env.example: DATABASE_URL missing pgbouncer=true — required for transaction-mode connection pooling.
__bt2/.env.example: DATABASE_URL missing connection_limit=N — set connection_limit=1 (default). Override: add CONNECTION_LIMIT_OVERRIDE_REASON comment.
__bt2/.env.example: DIRECT_URL not found in .env.example — needed for 'prisma db push/migrate' (port 5432 is OK there).
